_why: ADR 0028's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
The 'buffers' clause of Jeske's sentence. See adr-0032-cofactors.json
for why the four checks she named were re-derived as one unit.

mutations.description: is_same becomes the negative test (status != different)
mutations._note: The inversion the three states exist to prevent: `unknown` and `not_reported` must never read as agreement. Same shape as ADR 0029's is_wild_type, in a different module -- which is why both were written the positive way and both are mutated here.

mutations.description: compare on cid rather than PubChem parent (the salt case)
mutations._note: Tris and Tris-HCl are different CIDs and the same buffer. Comparing raw cid reports two rows as using different buffers when they do not.
